verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: quem não entra pela porta no aprisco das ovelhas, mas sobe por outra parte, esse é ladrão e salteador.
verses.en_web: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, He who does not go through the door into the place where the sheep are kept, but gets in by some other way, is a thief and an outlaw.

verses.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.pt: Mas o que entra pela porta é o pastor das ovelhas.
verses.en_web: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.en_bbe: He who goes in by the door is the keeper of the sheep.

verses.en: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verses.pt: A este o porteiro abre; e as ovelhas ouvem a sua voz; e ele chama pelo nome as suas ovelhas, e as conduz para fora.
verses.en_web: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
verses.en_bbe: The porter lets him in; and the sheep give ear to his voice; he says over the names of the sheep, and takes them out.

verses.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.pt: Depois de conduzir para fora todas as que lhe pertencem, vai adiante delas, e as ovelhas o seguem, porque conhecem a sua voz;
verses.en_web: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.en_bbe: When he has got them all out, he goes before them, and the sheep go after him, for they have knowledge of his voice.

verses.en: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.pt: mas de modo algum seguirão o estranho, antes fugirão dele, porque não conhecem a voz dos estranhos.
verses.en_web: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
verses.en_bbe: They will not go after another who is not their keeper, but will go from him in flight, because his voice is strange to them.

verses.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.pt: Jesus propôs-lhes esta parábola, mas eles não entenderam o que era que lhes dizia.
verses.en_web: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
verses.en_bbe: In this Jesus was teaching them in the form of a story: but what he said was not clear to them.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.pt: Tornou, pois, Jesus a dizer-lhes: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: eu sou a porta das ovelhas.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
verses.en_bbe: So Jesus said again, Truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.pt: Todos quantos vieram antes de mim são ladrões e salteadores; mas as ovelhas não os ouviram.
verses.en_web: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
verses.en_bbe: All who came before me are thieves and outlaws: but the sheep did not give ear to them.

verses.en: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.pt: Eu sou a porta; se alguém entrar a casa; o filho fica entrará e sairá, e achará pastagens.
verses.en_web: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
verses.en_bbe: I am the door: if any man goes in through me he will have salvation, and will go in and go out, and will get food.

verses.en: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.pt: O ladrão não vem senão para roubar, matar e destruir; eu vim para que tenham vida e a tenham em abundância.
verses.en_web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
verses.en_bbe: The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.

verses.en: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.pt: Eu sou o bom pastor; o bom pastor dá a sua vida pelas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.en_bbe: I am the good keeper of sheep: the good keeper gives his life for the sheep.

verses.en: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
verses.pt: Mas o que é mercenário, e não pastor, de quem não são as ovelhas, vendo vir o lobo, deixa as ovelhas e foge; e o lobo as arrebata e dispersa.
verses.en_web: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.
verses.en_bbe: He who is a servant, and not the keeper or the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming and goes in flight, away from the sheep; and the wolf comes down on them and sends them in all directions:

verses.en: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.pt: Ora, o mercenário foge porque é mercenário, e não se importa com as ovelhas.
verses.en_web: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.
verses.en_bbe: Because he is a servant he has no interest in the sheep.

verses.en: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.pt: Eu sou o bom pastor; conheço as minhas ovelhas, e elas me conhecem,
verses.en_web: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
verses.en_bbe: I am the good keeper; I have knowledge of my sheep, and they have knowledge of me,

verses.en: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.pt: assim como o Pai me conhece e eu conheço o Pai; e dou a minha vida pelas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.en_bbe: Even as the Father has knowledge of me and I of the Father; and I am giving my life for the sheep.

verses.en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.pt: Tenho ainda outras ovelhas que não são deste aprisco; a essas também me importa conduzir, e elas ouvirão a minha voz; e haverá um rebanho e um pastor.
verses.en_web: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
verses.en_bbe: And I have other sheep which are not of this field: I will be their guide in the same way, and they will give ear to my voice, so there will be one flock and one keeper.

verses.en: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.pt: Por isto o Pai me ama, porque dou a minha vida para a retomar.
verses.en_web: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason am I loved by the Father, because I give up my life so that I may take it again.

verses.en: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.pt: Ninguém ma tira de mim, mas eu de mim mesmo a dou; tenho autoridade para a dar, e tenho autoridade para retomá-la. Este mandamento recebi de meu Pai.
verses.en_web: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
verses.en_bbe: No one takes it away from me; I give it up of myself. I have power to give it up, and I have power to take it again. These orders I have from my Father.

verses.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
verses.pt: Por causa dessas palavras, houve outra dissensão entre os judeus.
verses.en_web: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.en_bbe: There was a division again among the Jews because of these words.

verses.en: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
verses.pt: E muitos deles diziam: Tem demônio, e perdeu o juízo; por que o escutais?
verses.en_web: Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
verses.en_bbe: And a number of them said, He has an evil spirit and is out of his mind; why do you give ear to him?

verses.en: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.pt: Diziam outros: Essas palavras não são de quem está endemoninhado; pode porventura um demônio abrir os olhos aos cegos?
verses.en_web: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
verses.en_bbe: Others said, These are not the words of one who has an evil spirit. Is it possible for an evil spirit to make blind people see?

verses.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.pt: Celebrava-se então em Jerusalém a festa da dedicação. E era inverno.
verses.en_web: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Then came the feast of the opening of the Temple in Jerusalem: it was winter;

verses.en: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
verses.pt: Andava Jesus passeando no templo, no pórtico de Salomão.
verses.en_web: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus was walking in the Temple, in Solomon's covered way.

verses.en: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
verses.pt: Rodearam-no, pois, os judeus e lhe perguntavam: Até quando nos deixarás perplexos? Se tu és o Cristo, dize-no-lo abertamente.
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Jews came round him, saying, how long are you going to keep us in doubt? If you are the Christ, say so clearly.

verses.en: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Já vo-lo disse, e não credes. As obras que eu faço em nome de meu Pai, essas dão testemunho de mim.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, I have said it and you have no belief: the works which I do in my Father's name, these give witness about me.

verses.en: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.pt: Mas vós não credes, porque não sois das minhas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
verses.en_bbe: But you have no belief because you are not of my sheep.

verses.en: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.pt: As minhas ovelhas ouvem a minha voz, e eu as conheço, e elas me seguem;
verses.en_web: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
verses.en_bbe: My sheep give ear to my voice, and I have knowledge of them, and they come after me:

verses.en: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.pt: eu lhes dou a vida eterna, e jamais perecerão; e ninguém as arrebatará da minha mão.
verses.en_web: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
verses.en_bbe: And I give them eternal life; they will never come to destruction, and no one will ever take them out of my hand.

verses.en: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.pt: Meu Pai, que mas deu, é maior do que todos; e ninguém pode arrebatá-las da mão de meu Pai.
verses.en_web: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.en_bbe: That which my Father has given to me has more value than all; and no one is able to take anything out of the Father's hand.

verses.en: I and my Father are one.
verses.pt: Eu e o Pai somos um.
verses.en_web: I and the Father are one.”
verses.en_bbe: I and my Father are one.

verses.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.pt: Os judeus pegaram então outra vez em pedras para o apedrejar.
verses.en_web: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Jews took up stones again to send at him.

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Muitas obras boas da parte de meu Pai vos tenho mostrado; por qual destas obras ides apedrejar-me?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them in answer, I have let you see a number of good works from the Father; for which of those works are you stoning me?

verses.en: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe os judeus: Não é por nenhuma obra boa que vamos apedrejar-te, mas por blasfêmia; e porque, sendo tu homem, te fazes Deus.
verses.en_web: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
verses.en_bbe: This was their answer: We are not stoning you for a good work but for evil words; because being a man you make yourself God.

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
verses.pt: Tornou-lhes Jesus: Não está escrito na vossa lei: Eu disse: Vós sois deuses?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
verses.en_bbe: In answer, Jesus said, Is there not a saying in your law, I said, You are gods?

verses.en: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.pt: Se a lei chamou deuses àqueles a quem a palavra de Deus foi dirigida (e a Escritura não pode ser anulada),
verses.en_web: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
verses.en_bbe: If he said they were gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Writings may not be broken),

verses.en: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
verses.pt: àquele a quem o Pai santificou, e enviou ao mundo, dizeis vós: Blasfemas; porque eu disse: Sou Filho de Deus?
verses.en_web: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’
verses.en_bbe: Do you say of him whom the Father made holy and sent into the world, Your words are evil; because I said, I am God's Son?

verses.en: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.pt: Se não faço as obras de meu Pai, não me acrediteis.
verses.en_web: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
verses.en_bbe: If I am not doing the works of my Father, do not have belief in me;

verses.en: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.pt: Mas se as faço, embora não me creiais a mim, crede nas obras; para que entendais e saibais que o Pai está em mim e eu no Pai.
verses.en_web: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
verses.en_bbe: But if I am doing them, then have belief in the works even if you have no belief in me; so that you may see clearly and be certain that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

verses.en: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.pt: Outra vez, pois, procuravam prendê-lo; mas ele lhes escapou das mãos.
verses.en_web: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
verses.en_bbe: Then again they made an attempt to take him; but he got away from them.

verses.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.pt: E retirou-se de novo para além do Jordão, para o lugar onde João batizava no princípio; e ali ficou.
verses.en_web: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.
verses.en_bbe: And he went again to the other side of the Jordan, to the place where John first gave baptism; and he was there for a time.

verses.en: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.pt: Muitos foram ter com ele, e diziam: João, na verdade, não fez sinal algum, mas tudo quanto disse deste homem era verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
verses.en_bbe: And a great number of people came to him, saying, John did no sign: but everything John said of this man was true.

verses.en: And many believed on him there.
verses.pt: E muitos ali creram nele.
verses.en_web: Many believed in him there.
verses.en_bbe: And a number came to have faith in him there.
